guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設：輪徑與切削線速度採 D=0.84 m；本課公式結果 158.336 m/min，非現場額定值。
教學假設：徑向去除與壽命帳採 D0=840 mm；本課公式結果 837 mm，非現場額定值。
教學假設：切屑體積與節拍採 width=6 mm；本課公式結果 240 mm3/s，非現場額定值。
教學假設：加工設備穩態熱路採 P=900 W；本課公式結果 61.5 degC，非現場額定值。
教學假設：加工激振與結構頻率採 k=1.8e+06 N/m；本課公式結果 1.94924 Hz，非現場額定值。
教學假設：刀具磨耗與輪廓採 depth=0.6 mm；本課公式結果 0.2 mm，非現場額定值。
factsEn: Teaching assumption for wheel diameter and cutting speed: D=0.84 m; this model gives 158.336 m/min, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for radial removal and life accounting: D0=840 mm; this model gives 837 mm, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for chip volume and processing cycle: width=6 mm; this model gives 240 mm3/s, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for steady heat paths in machining equipment: P=900 W; this model gives 61.5 degC, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for machining excitation and structural frequency: k=1.8e+06 N/m; this model gives 1.94924 Hz, not a field rating.
Teaching assumption for tool wear and profile quality: depth=0.6 mm; this model gives 0.2 mm, not a field rating.
timeline: 2010　機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。
2015　品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。
2023　機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。
timelineEn: 2010 — This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published.
2015 — The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published.
2023 — An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published.
codes: ISO 12100:2010 機械風險評估與降低方法，非設備額定證明
ISO 13849-1:2023 安全相關控制設計，教材不宣告性能等級
codesEn: ISO 12100:2010 machinery risk assessment and reduction, not equipment rating certification
ISO 13849-1:2023 safety-related control design, with no performance-level claim for this lesson
landmarksEn: Hong Kong MTR Pat Heung Depot
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出軌距與限界、運輸需求、供電與號誌以及施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in gauge and clearance, service demand, power, signalling and construction methods.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：車輪在軌鏇削設備
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Underfloor wheel-lathe systems
guides.concept: 本課聚焦輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測。從輪徑與切削線速度建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把加工設備穩態熱路與輪廓量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以輪型與缺陷案例矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
guides.conceptEn: This course studies geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining. Start with wheel diameter and cutting speed to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady heat paths in machining equipment with combining profile-measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through wheel-type and defect case matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
procedure: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。切削線速度由輪徑與轉速共同決定，相同轉速在不同直徑會造成不同刀具接觸條件。輪對鏇削還要考慮夾持剛度、材料硬點和輪廓基準；把工具轉速設定正確，並不能保證完成後輪廓與同軸度符合需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。
本單元把單側切深換算成直徑耗用，將每次修整量保留在輪對履歷以檢查剩餘材料。徑向切深在直徑上會出現兩倍的減少，輪徑耗用應與可維修壽命一起追蹤。修掉一處缺陷所需的最小去除量可能決定整個輪對的加工深度；只追求表面光滑而忽略剩餘輪緣與直徑，可能提早耗盡零件壽命。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。
本單元以矩形切屑類比計算去除率，另外計入檢測與重工時間以免只追求刀具接觸時間最短。體積去除率由截面乘相對進給估算，能用來連結節拍、切屑與能量需求。增加去除率會同時提高熱與力的負擔，實際效果受刀具、材料與剛度限制；縮短加工時間若造成重工，總維修週期反而可能增加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。
本單元以等效持續熱源觀察冷卻路徑，區分機體穩態溫升與刀尖短時高溫不能由同一模型代表。穩態溫升由發熱乘等效熱阻決定，散熱路徑和熱源功率同樣重要。風道阻塞、接觸面鬆動與環境升溫都可能造成相同的最高溫度；若只換大風機而不追蹤熱路，可能改善外殼卻讓內部熱點繼續惡化。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：單節點線性穩態熱阻模型，未解析空間熱點與瞬態熱容。
本單元用單自由度模型比較支承剛度與等效質量，指出自然頻率接近激振並不直接給出振幅。單自由度固有頻率由剛度與質量比的平方根決定。提高剛度可能移開一個激振頻率，也可能移近另一個頻率；阻尼控制峰值而不只改變頻率，因此僅比較靜態變形不能預測動態放大。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：線性無阻尼單自由度頻率，未含多模態與輪軌或磁路耦合。
本單元比較刀具使用次數與輪廓殘差，檢查材料硬點是否讓固定線性磨耗率失去代表性。線性磨耗率可以作短區間履歷比較，但磨耗機制可能隨潤滑、負載與表面狀態改變。早期磨合與後期疲勞不一定沿同一斜率；把短期平均率外推到全壽命，容易忽略加速劣化及偶發損傷。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：固定工況短區間線性外推，不是剩餘壽命保證。
本單元分離輪廓掃描重複性與夾持基準偏差，避免把同一基準的相關誤差當成獨立來源。獨立零均值誤差的變異數可以相加，因此標準差以平方和開根號合成。這個做法不適合直接合併最大容差或共同偏差；一旦共享基準造成相關性，協方差項就必須回到計算中，不能繼續假裝量測彼此獨立。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立隨機標準差，不代表確定的最大偏移界。
本單元直接使用假想輪面圓周速度計算掃描間距，另外檢查徑向振動和感測頻寬以免把資料間距誤當缺陷解析度。固定時間取樣在移動系統中對應空間間隔，速度越高相同頻率越容易漏過狹窄特徵。時間戳抖動會讓空間取樣不均勻；提高取樣率仍需足夠感測頻寬與抗混疊處理，不能只增加資料列數。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定輪面圓周速度與等間隔取樣，不包含輪面滑動、徑向振動或感測頻寬。
本單元將輪徑、輪廓、圓度與資料歸檔視為不同驗證工作，將量具重設和異常重測納入節拍。測試工時包含案例執行與環境設定、資料復原及證據整理。平行化只有在資源和狀態真正獨立時有效；把多個會修改同一狀態的測試同時執行，可能造成結果不可重現，表面節省時間卻增加診斷成本。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：確定平均案例時間的串行估算，未含故障重測與資源衝突。
本單元對不同輪型、偏磨與表面缺陷建立案例，明列未加工過的組合以限制品質推論。測試覆蓋率只對已定義的分母有意義。需求、狀態、轉移與危害各有不同分母，執行很多正常案例仍可能漏掉罕見但重要的交接；同一案例重跑多次不會自動增加獨立需求的覆蓋。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
procedureEn: Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Cutting surface speed depends on diameter and rotational speed, so the same rotation rate produces different tool conditions on different wheels. Reprofiling also depends on clamping stiffness, hard spots and profile reference. Correct speed setting does not by itself establish final profile or concentricity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings.

Convert radial cut depth to diameter consumption, retaining each reprofiling removal in wheelset history to track remaining material. Radial removal reduces diameter by twice the cut depth, so diameter consumption belongs in life tracking. The removal needed for one defect may govern the entire wheelset. Optimizing surface appearance while ignoring remaining flange and diameter can consume useful life prematurely. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified.

Use a rectangular-chip analogy to estimate removal rate and separately include inspection and rework rather than minimizing tool-contact time alone. Volumetric removal rate is cross-sectional area times relative feed, linking cycle time, chips and energy demand. Higher removal increases thermal and mechanical loading, limited by tooling, material and stiffness. A shorter cut can lengthen the total maintenance cycle when it creates rework. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Conceptual rectangular chip section, not an actual reprofiling tool path or production setting.

Observe cooling paths under equivalent sustained heating, distinguishing machine steady temperature from transient tool-tip heat that this model cannot represent. Steady temperature rise equals heat generation times thermal resistance, making heat paths as important as source power. Blocked airflow, loose interfaces and warmer ambient conditions can produce similar maxima. A larger fan may cool the enclosure while an internal hotspot continues to worsen. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Single-node linear steady thermal-resistance model without spatial hotspots or transient heat capacity.

Use a single-degree model to compare support stiffness and effective mass, noting that proximity to excitation frequency does not directly determine amplitude. A single-degree natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. Stiffening can move away from one excitation yet toward another. Damping controls the resonant peak as well as frequency effects, so static deflection alone cannot predict dynamic amplification. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Linear undamped single-degree frequency without multimode, wheel-rail or magnetic coupling.

Compare tool-use count with profile residuals, checking whether hard material spots make a constant linear wear rate unrepresentative. A linear wear rate supports short-interval history comparisons, but lubrication, load and surface state can change the mechanism. Running-in and later fatigue need not share one slope. Extrapolating a short average across a whole life can miss accelerating deterioration and incidental damage. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Short-range linear extrapolation at fixed conditions, not a remaining-life guarantee.

Separate profile-scanner repeatability from clamping-datum bias, avoiding treatment of errors sharing one reference as independent sources. Variances of independent zero-mean errors add, giving a root-sum-square standard deviation. This is not a way to combine maximum tolerances or common bias. When a shared datum creates correlation, covariance terms belong in the calculation rather than assuming continued independence. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent random standard deviations, not a deterministic maximum displacement bound.

Use assumed wheel-surface circumferential speed directly to calculate scan spacing, then check radial vibration and sensor bandwidth rather than equating sample spacing with defect resolution. Time sampling in a moving system corresponds to spatial spacing; at higher speed, the same rate can miss narrow features. Timestamp jitter makes spatial samples nonuniform. A higher rate still requires adequate sensor bandwidth and anti-alias filtering, rather than merely more rows of data. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant circumferential surface speed and regular samples, excluding surface slip, radial vibration and sensor bandwidth.

Treat diameter, profile, roundness and archiving as separate verification tasks, including gauge reset and anomaly reruns in the cycle. Test effort includes case execution, setup, state restoration and evidence handling. Parallelism helps only when resources and state are genuinely independent. Concurrent tests modifying one shared state can become irreproducible, apparently saving execution time while increasing diagnostic cost. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Serial estimate with deterministic mean case time; failure reruns and resource conflicts are excluded.

Build cases for wheel types, uneven wear and surface defects, listing unmachined combinations explicitly to bound quality claims. Coverage is meaningful only relative to its defined denominator. Requirements, states, transitions and hazards have different denominators. Many normal cases can still omit a rare but important handoff, and repeating one case does not automatically cover additional independent requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
evidence: 只把輪徑 D 從 0.84 改成 0.924 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 158.336 變為 174.17 m/min。先說明「輪徑與切削線速度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
只把單側徑向去除 depth 從 1.5 改成 1.65 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 837 變為 836.7 mm。先說明「徑向去除與壽命帳」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
只把相對進給速度 feed 從 100 改成 110 mm/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 240 變為 264 mm3/s。先說明「切屑體積與節拍」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
只把等效熱阻 Rth 從 0.035 改成 0.0385 K/W（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 61.5 變為 64.65 degC。先說明「加工設備穩態熱路」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
只把等效剛度 k 從 1.8e+06 改成 1.98e+06 N/m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 1.94924 變為 2.04438 Hz。先說明「加工激振與結構頻率」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
evidenceEn: Change only wheel diameter D from 0.84 to 0.924 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 158.336 to 174.17 m/min. Explain the causal direction for wheel diameter and cutting speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

Change only radial removal per side depth from 1.5 to 1.65 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 837 to 836.7 mm. Explain the causal direction for radial removal and life accounting, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

Change only relative feed speed feed from 100 to 110 mm/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 240 to 264 mm3/s. Explain the causal direction for chip volume and processing cycle, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

Change only equivalent thermal resistance Rth from 0.035 to 0.0385 K/W (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 61.5 to 64.65 degC. Explain the causal direction for steady heat paths in machining equipment, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

Change only equivalent stiffness k from 1.8e+06 to 1.98e+06 N/m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 1.94924 to 2.04438 Hz. Explain the causal direction for machining excitation and structural frequency, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
pitfalls: 以標稱輪徑代替磨耗後直徑會錯估速度，輪面滑動則使驅動滾輪轉速不再代表輪對轉速。回到「輪徑與切削線速度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
只記刀具接觸時間會低估設備占用，刀具磨耗造成去除率下降也可能被程序時間掩蓋。回到「切屑體積與節拍」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
只增加剛度而忽略激振頻帶可能使振動更大，感測器裝在節點則可能漏掉主要模態。回到「加工激振與結構頻率」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
共同基準誤差會使所有讀值同向偏移，重複次數增加也無法把這種偏差平均掉。回到「輪廓量測誤差合成」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
省略復原步驟會讓前案狀態污染後案，僅報告成功案例時間則低估總測試成本。回到「加工後驗證完整工時」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
pitfallsEn: Nominal instead of worn diameter biases speed; roller slip makes drive-roller rotation differ from wheelset rotation. Trace the input chain for wheel diameter and cutting speed. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Recording only tool-contact time understates equipment occupation; tool wear can reduce removal rate without appearing in nominal program duration. Trace the input chain for chip volume and processing cycle. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Stiffening without considering excitation bands can increase vibration; a sensor at a node may miss the dominant mode. Trace the input chain for machining excitation and structural frequency. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

A common datum error shifts readings together, and additional repetition cannot average away that shared bias. Trace the input chain for combining profile-measurement uncertainty. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

Omitted restoration contaminates later tests with earlier state; reporting only successful durations understates total effort. Trace the input chain for complete post-machining verification effort. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

related.title: 列車轉向架更換設備
related.transfer: 可遷移「輪徑與切削線速度」與「輪廓量測誤差合成」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；列車轉向架更換設備的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Wheel diameter and cutting speed" and "Combining profile-measurement uncertainty" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bogie-exchange equipment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測；列車轉向架更換設備則以轉向架更換的載重分配同步與定位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining; Bogie-exchange equipment centres on load sharing synchronization and positioning in bogie exchange, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「輪徑與切削線速度」與「車體承載點平均反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到列車轉向架更換設備，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” and “Mean reactions at body supports”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 車輪在軌鏇削設備
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用徑向去除與壽命帳及加工後驗證完整工時連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through radial removal and life accounting and complete post-machining verification effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
